name: ZRL 2026/27 R1 W5: Green to Screen (scratch race)
notes: km = race distance from the start, as in Zwift Insider's guide. Scratch race: only the finish counts; the sprint and KOM segments are not scored, they matter for their power-up arches (feather, van or AERO, 1/3 each). Grades of the Manhattan climb and the Rise to circle, and the escalators' places, from the route's own profile (Sauce route data). The escalators are boosted ~20% subway ramps of about 5 s each (km 8.2, 14.1, 20.4, 27.0); the boost scales with W/kg since Zwift 1.104.

items.name: Times Square lap arch
items.info: 250 XP if you hold no power-up

items.name: Rise to circle
items.info: with the last escalator at 27.0; then the flat final 1.2 km
